hazards.evidence: The staircase has a handrail only on the right side; no handrail is visible on the left.
The right-hand rail ends well before the bottom of the staircase.
Shoes and a stack of folded linens are placed on the stair treads.
The staircase is dimly lit, with substantial shadow over several steps despite a small wall light.
Carpet is torn and loose around a tread, creating ragged, unsecured edges.
A stair tread is damaged and uneven, with exposed wood and broken surface material.
